# Video

<!-- agent-docs:start (generated by eacp-agent-docs; edits here are overwritten) -->

## Headers

- [Audio.h](Audio.h): One block of planar float audio, borrowed: a pointer per channel, numFrames samples in each. (declares `AudioBuffer`, `AudioSpec`, `audioBitrateFor`, `audioTimeFor`)
- [AudioRing.h](AudioRing.h): The lock-free handover between the audio thread pushing blocks and the recorder's drain feeding them to the encoder. (declares `AudioRing`)
- [Encoder.h](Encoder.h): Composites a straight-RGBA Image over black into an opaque, premultiplied BGRA byte buffer, row by row honouring dstStride (which may exceed width*4 for a padded target). (declares `compositeOverBlackBGRA`, `VideoSpec`, `EncoderSpec`, `Encoder`, `makeEncoder`)
- [ScreenCapture.h](ScreenCapture.h): The Screen capture tier: taps the system compositor for a view's host window (ScreenCaptureKit on macOS, Windows.Graphics.Capture on Windows) and feeds the live composited window -- 2D, GPU and WebView together -- to the encoder in real time. (declares `ScreenCapture`, `makeScreenCapture`)
- [SyntheticClip.h](SyntheticClip.h): How to build a synthetic clip. (declares `SyntheticClipOptions`, `syntheticFrameColor`, `syntheticFrameCount`, `writeSyntheticClip`, `cachedSyntheticClip`)
- [VideoRecorder.h](VideoRecorder.h): declares `CaptureMode`, `hasScreenCapturePermission`, `requestScreenCapturePermission`, `RecordingOptions`, `VideoRecorder`

## Submodules

- [Decode](Decode/README.md): declares `VideoInfo`, `SeekMode`, `Decoder`
- [Demux](Demux/README.md): declares `Mp4Codec`, `Mp4Sample`, `Mp4TrackInfo`
